fix: Add the inbox-add executor that docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md names (item cli-agent-tool-surface): validate the request, file the item with source set to the request id, and record the item id in the lineage index. Until the executor exists, a refused inbox-add emits an ERROR signal with the request path and the item id, and evolve wave supply or the boundary report lists it, so no item is lost without a trace.
summary: agentclass/table.go:66 gives inbox add the class R with the kind inbox-add, and the CLI tells a phase agent to write requests/inbox-add-<n>.json. agentrequest/channel.go:190 refuses each kind except dispatch (precondition kind, stage shadow). 11 requests in cycles 2191, 2200, 2271 and 2460 were refused and no item was filed. Cycle 2460 lost the 6 move items of docs/plans/split-cmd-evolve-2026-11.md; the console filed them by hand on 2026-11-17. The refusal decision also has no reason code (SIGNALCENTER_MISSING_REASON).
title: The request channel refuses each inbox-add request, so items that phase agents file are lost
